summary: This file defines a static class responsible for last-minute localization in a .NET web application. It provides methods to translate UI fields and display values at runtime, based on the user's session locale.
purpose: To translate interface fields (labels, literals) and display strings such as file types and last login timestamps, depending on the user's language preference in the session.

workflows.name: Translate UI Fields
steps: Check if alternate language fields are enabled in session.
Iterate through provided UI controls and string values.
If the control is a Label or Literal and not null, assign the translated value.

workflows.name: Translate File Type
steps: Return the appropriate file type string based on locale.

workflows.name: Translate Last Login Timestamp
steps: Check if alternate language fields are used.
Replace month names in the LastLogin string with localized versions.

business_rules: Translation is done at the UI layer when logic depends on the English value of fields.
Fields and translation values arrays must be the same size.
If alternate language is not used, original (English/default) values are shown.
validations: Controls and translation values must not be null before assignment.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields flag checked before translating fields or strings.
system_behavior: Dynamically translates fields and labels at runtime if alternate language is active.
Localizes date/month values in display strings.
content_gaps: Does not specify translation for languages other than French.
No error handling for mismatched array sizes or unexpected control types.
